scope: Targeted review of Ossie-aligned semantic-context retrieval; primarily 2025-2026 publications
deduplication: Conference and preprint versions are one work; use DOI or arXiv ID, then normalized title and author identity.

works.title: JoinGR: Learning to Traverse Join Graphs for Table Retrieval
works.review_depth: Metadata, methods, training, evaluation, and limitations inspected
works.comparison_boundary: Learned traversal and cross-domain transfer are prior work; no chronological Ossie-context evaluation established.

works.title: Finding the Right Tables and Columns: A Benchmark and Corpus-Adaptive Embeddings for SQL Schema Retrieval
works.review_depth: Metadata, methods, results, training appendix, and leakage/held-out-corpus analyses inspected
works.comparison_boundary: Retrieval per database group; metadata representation includes sampled rows; corpus adaptation and corpus holdout are distinct.

works.review_depth: Official metadata and abstract; earlier PDF retrieval failed
works.comparison_boundary: Detailed reproduction choices are not verified.

works.title: DBCopilot: Natural Language Querying over Massive Databases via Schema Routing
works.status: EDBT 2025; publication-year inclusion, not a 2025-first-release claim
works.review_depth: Official PDF methods and unseen-schema ablation inspected through web extraction
works.comparison_boundary: Synthetic catalog injection into parameters differs from index-only new-table support.

works.title: Extractive Schema Linking for Text-to-SQL
works.review_depth: Methods inspected in the earlier review
works.comparison_boundary: Independent schema scores do not certify joint business sufficiency.

works.title: REaR: Retrieve, Expand and Refine for Effective Multitable Retrieval
works.review_depth: Official conference metadata; preprint methods, experimental setup, and description prompts inspected
works.comparison_boundary: No online LLM retrieval calls does not mean no offline LLM enrichment.

works.title: CORE-T: COherent REtrieval of Tables for Text-to-SQL
works.status: 2026 arXiv preprint; inspected v3 dated 2026-08-30; conference status not inferred from repository name
works.review_depth: Methods, pooled evaluation, baseline implementation notes, and incremental-cache appendix inspected
evidence_sections: Appendix C: Scalability and incremental maintenance
works.comparison_boundary: Uses sampled rows and value compatibility; incremental design is not a longitudinal semantic-context benchmark.

works.title: Guided Table Retrieval for Structured Data Search
works.status: 2026 arXiv preprint; first version August 12; v2 August 13
works.review_depth: Metadata, retrieval phases, graph construction, and reachability inspected
works.comparison_boundary: Directed rooted left-join trees and sampled-value evidence restrict direct transfer.

works.title: Graph-Link: Bridging the Semantic-Structural Gap in Text-to-SQL via Constrained Subgraph Induction
works.status: ICML 2026, Proceedings of Machine Learning Research 306
works.review_depth: Official metadata, PDF methods, algorithm, limitations, and future work inspected
works.comparison_boundary: Structural connectivity and inferred similarity edges do not establish approved business relationships.

works.title: SchemaGraphSQL: Efficient Schema Linking with Pathfinding Graph Algorithms for Text-to-SQL on Large-Scale Databases
works.review_depth: Official metadata and abstract
works.comparison_boundary: Detailed algorithm reproduction remains unverified; inferred joins need independent review.

works.title: Can we Retrieve Everything All at Once? ARM: An Alignment-Oriented LLM-based Retrieval Method
works.review_depth: Official paper abstract, conference listing, and author repository pipeline inspected
works.comparison_boundary: Treat as a related LLM-assisted baseline; full artifact portability was not audited.

works.title: Plugging Schema Graph into Multi-Table QA: A Human-Guided Framework for Reducing LLM Reliance
works.review_depth: Official metadata and selected PDF methods, CISS context, and limitations through web extraction
works.comparison_boundary: Real-world domain evaluation and curated relationships are already present in prior work.

works.status: 2025; paper states KDD SKnowLLM workshop acceptance

works.title: Solid-SQL: Enhanced Schema-linking based In-context Learning for Robust Text-to-SQL
works.review_depth: Official metadata and abstract
works.comparison_boundary: Perturbation robustness is established; full training reproduction was not inspected.

works.title: SQUAB: Evaluating LLM robustness to Ambiguous and Unanswerable Questions in Semantic Parsing
works.review_depth: Official metadata and abstract
works.comparison_boundary: Automatic challenge generation does not replace independent expert truth or natural-query prevalence.

limits: This inventory is a selected reading list, not the total number of screened search hits.
Some entries deliberately retain short citation labels instead of inventing unverified full metadata.
Publication versions are deduplicated; an arXiv preprint is not treated as peer reviewed without an official proceedings record.
No paper result or author repository was reproduced.
No training dataset was imported or redistributed.
Absence from this search cannot establish research priority.
